name: RedCode
description: RedCode is a benchmark designed to evaluate the safety of code agents in risky code execution and generation. It includes RedCode-Exec with 4,050 risky test cases across 25 vulnerability types and 8 domains, and RedCode-Gen with 160 prompts to assess harmful code generation.
reputation: RedCode is a recent safety benchmark for code agents, introduced to probe risky code execution and harmful code generation.
notes: Includes Docker environments for execution and covers diverse input formats including code snippets and natural text.
